scope: Independent source review of node-local Positive lock classification, source due and three-leg spend DATA proposals; not native acceptance or spending authority.

resolved_review_findings.issue: A prepared completion/source proposal could pass funding-only CAS after Case status or other guard changes.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: The proposal retains and compares the full ResultRow, CaseRow and FundingRow; a separate receipt snapshot comparison checks exact unique before receipts.

resolved_review_findings.issue: A later spend could rewind the recorded settlement clock.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Funding/case/last-settlement/duty/response/service origins must not be after the new settlement; identical last settlement event positions are refused.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Different accepted material or attempts could duplicate the same completion/carrier in one proposal.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Completion is once per case/plan and carrier is once per physical transaction within a proposal; global prior-paid markers remain a native owner obligation.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Distinct current outpoints could represent the same case or original funding output.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: The view rejects duplicate case/original/current outpoints and overlap with legacy or provisional lock sets.

reviewed_invariants: Receipt identity is the existing case/kind/source/unit key; provider, Panel, attempt and transport do not create a new source due.
Source due is accounted on the first receipt; settlement None is not delivery or absence of a due. Zero-fee receipts still retain identity.
Case usage fee is source-only; control, carrier, completion and burn remain separate Court whole fees.
One classifier rejects duplicate inputs, provisional spends and multiple locked inputs across old and new namespaces; a Positive escrow must be input zero.
Actual supplied populated entry amount/refund script, current transaction ID, recipient output amount/script and exact continuation are checked; unsupported nonempty payloads are refused.
Only fee remaining funds fees/burn; capital and surplus remain separate. Foreign outputs cannot consume the protected escrow and all burn categories share one checked actual fee budget.
Refunds retain three-leg accounting and a resolution reference check; reference equality is explicitly not liability discharge authority.
Old FundingTerms identifiers/rows/relay payloads are not reinterpreted, and no new global key, wire tag or hash/signature domain is introduced.
The proposal has private construction but remains DATA. require_native_commit always returns ActualAcceptedMoneyContext missing and cannot authorize spending.

node-all-targets-clippy-initial.scope: No-default all-targets node crate Clippy with --no-deps -- -D warnings; root execution inspected, not rerun by reviewer.

evidence_notes: All final combined-run recorded source hashes match the bytes reviewed here. The raw log contains 44 successes: dues 7, native_funds 15, native 15 and rows 7.
The earlier source-dues lib.rs hash differs because native_funds module registration followed that run. Both dues source/test hashes and common rows match; the original record is preserved.

Production-lib and subsequent all-targets Clippy records both have exit zero and matching source hashes. The latter includes no-default test targets with --no-deps -- -D warnings, but does not claim default-feature TIR targets.
These executions were performed by the root agent. This independent review only inspected their raw output and metadata and did not rerun them.
limits: Lock-set completeness, actual accepted lineage/prefix/import generation and irreversible context must be derived and rechecked by native owners. Equal DTOs cannot detect rollback ABA.
The supplied populated UTXO entries and zero-signature DATA fixtures do not establish actual UTXO existence, ordinary script validation, funding admission or coin locks.
A4 must resolve first eligible accepted duty/response, canonical unit bounds, provider/rate and the whole source quote before atomically applying due and money proposals.
Court whole fees are deduplicated only inside the proposal. Cross-settlement once-only markers must be checked and written by the native owner.

Unpaid earned dues, reserved future fees, capital liability and surplus return conditions must be derived from current canonical preimages; a liability reference or admission expiry cannot authorize refund.
Actual block/mempool/template connection, same-mergeset lock installation, one-writer PALW/UTXO batch, failure atomicity, reorg/undo and IBD remain external integration requirements.
The 44-test run used no default features, so it does not re-execute the TIR adapter tests or demonstrate a multi-node native end-to-end lifecycle.
